title: Fabricate
description:
You follow the recipe for a piece of equipment: the one its entry prints, or the one the GM sets for an item or a change you put to them.

Commit as many materials as you like. Each one must carry at least one of the Types the recipe accepts. Their Material Values must add up to at least the recipe's cost. Each of the recipe's required Types must be carried by at least one committed material, and a single material can carry several. The materials are used up as soon as you commit them.

Then make the recipe's {{jet|Rolls}} in order, each with the {{caracteristique}} and {{dd}} it gives and the recipe's discipline as the {{aptitude}}. If they all succeed, the piece is made. At the first failure the work stops and the materials are lost.
